title: Taking the Photo Is Only Half the Job. Delivering It Is the Other Half
excerpt: Missouri is investigating a photography business after customers say they paid for weddings, births, and family photos and never received them. The camera work was not the failure. The delivery was.

title: A Cloudy Day Is Not Flat Light. It Is Light You Have Not Shaped Yet
excerpt: Overcast light looks flat because it comes from everywhere at once. Block part of the sky with a wall, an umbrella, or a roofline, and the direction comes back. Gray days reward photographers who shape light instead of waiting for it.

title: Thirty Years of Looking for One Giraffe in the Mist
excerpt: Wildlife photographer Paul Goldstein spent three decades looking for a giraffe emerging from mist in Kenya and failing. The frame that finally worked lasted about five minutes, and it won its category at Nature Photographer of the Year.
